## 19:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. A psalm of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. A psalm of David.

## 19:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** The-heavens declare the-glory of-God, and-the-work of-His-hands the-firmament proclaims.
- **LOGOS:** The heavens declare the glory of God, and the sky above proclaims His handiwork.
- **PNEUMA:** The heavens proclaim the glory of God. The skies display His craftsmanship.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 19:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Into-all the-earth goes-out their-line, and-to-the-end of-the-world their-words. For-the-sun He-has-set a-tent in-them.
- **LOGOS:** Their voice goes out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them He has set a tent for the sun,
- **PNEUMA:** Yet their message has gone throughout the earth, and their words to all the world. God has made the heavens a tent for the sun.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 19:6 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-it [is] like-a-bridegroom going-forth from-his-chamber; it-rejoices like-a-mighty-man to-run [its] course.
- **LOGOS:** which comes out like a bridegroom leaving his chamber, and, like a strong man, runs its course with joy.
- **PNEUMA:** It bursts forth like a radiant bridegroom after his wedding. It rejoices like a great athlete eager to run the race.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 19:13 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Errors — who can-discern? From-hidden-faults acquit-me.
- **LOGOS:** Who can discern his errors? Declare me innocent from hidden faults.
- **PNEUMA:** How can I know all the sins lurking in my heart? Cleanse me from these hidden faults.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 19:7 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** From-the-end of-the-heavens [is] its-going-forth, and-its-circuit [is] to their-ends; and-nothing is-hidden from-its-heat.
- **LOGOS:** Its rising is from the end of the heavens, and its circuit to the end of them, and there is nothing hidden from its heat.
- **PNEUMA:** The sun rises at one end of the heavens and follows its course to the other end. Nothing hides from its heat.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
